scope: Bounded read-only managed checker and publication audit; synthetic Store/process fixtures, no actual engineering release assertion

findings.observed: Real managed Store report accepted revision1 even though checker_version changed immediately after real derive_transition returned. No source file was changed; only version provider was patched.
findings.correction: Root added checker-version guard inside the acceptance transaction.

findings.observed: Native Windows process supervisor returned COMPLETED in0.25s; a descendant invisible after its immediate parent exited wrote a marker0.8s later. Child stdout and stderr were redirected, so log drain did not reveal it.
findings.reproduction: Parent child writes ready and waits for go. Supervisor cancellation poll writes go after current observe(parent). Child creates grandchild then exits before next poll; grandchild writes delayed marker. Uses real subprocess and psutil.
findings.implication: Observed process-set completion is weaker than creation-contained process-tree completion. This experiment is not a false native geometry verdict.
findings.suggested_boundary: Creation-time Windows Job Object containment or explicit weaker protocol claim; polling alone cannot close this race.

findings.observation: Store.record_verification builds report assurance in the parent before the transactional deadline guard. A slow or blocked builder may exceed the wall-clock budget; eventual deadline rejection prevents publication but does not supervise that parent work. SQLite connection lock wait is also up to30s.
findings.reproduction_idea: After a valid private receipt, delay build_report_assurance past a short shared deadline; expect no publication but elapsed time exceeding the budget. A separate worker/process boundary or bounded preparation contract is required for hard elapsed-time enforcement.

other_reviewed_guards: Managed execution binds candidate payload/root/project, origin and control request identities, baseline, report mission/rule/version, and deadline at report commit.
A newer execution invalidates prior token authority. Incomplete executions leave candidate UNKNOWN without report authority.
Frontier proposal status does not bypass native report completion or actual joint fitting-budget checks.
